اكتنزن (form VIII)
# اِكْتَنَزْنَ (iktanazna) /ik.ta.naz.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# اُكْتُنِزْنَ (uktunizna) /uk.tu.niz.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# اِكْتَنِزْنَ (iktanizna) /ik.ta.niz.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
